approaches.title: Priority-queue task/server simulation
approaches.summary: Simulate task arrivals and server availability with priority queues: choose the lightest, lowest-index free server, and track busy servers by completion time. Later revisions refine how tasks are assigned and how the queues are ordered.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial simulation assigns one task per iteration using priority queues; marked wrong.
Batches all currently eligible tasks onto free servers; marked wrong.
Extracts the server ordering into a static comparator while retaining the batching simulation.
Uses separate priority-queue comparators for free servers (weight, then index) and busy servers (completion time).
